title: Retrieval manifest, version 1 (osd.manifest/1)
description: What a person selected from the catalogue and where its files are. Written by `osd manifest` (and, later, the site), read by `osd get` and `osd.manifest.read`. Assets are the STAC Collection assets, which are the files the verifier hashed: a sample, never the whole dataset unless `coverage` says complete. Never carries credentials.

catalog_url.description: The STAC root the ids resolve against

selection.description: Collection selection or Item selection, never a mix

href.description: http(s), no userinfo, no signature or token in the query

file:checksum.description: Multihash as the STAC File extension states it; osd get accepts sha2-256 (1220…) only and refuses others loudly

licence.description: The record's licence object, copied whole; absent fields stay absent (unknown), nothing is invented

item_id.description: Item selection: the STAC Item id, or null when the feature has no Item

feature_id.description: Item selection: the map feature that was selected

origin_url.description: The publisher's page; the to-do address when assets are empty

known_issues.description: The record's known_issues, verbatim (publisher restrictions live here and in licence.redistribution)

assets.description: STAC asset key (a relative path) to asset; keys become paths under --dest/<collection_id>/

coverage.description: sampled: the files the verifier hashed, not the whole dataset

unresolved.description: Why no asset is listed; the origin page is the to-do
